music.title: Where We Used To Be
music.fit_hypothesis: First Xenoblade reference to audition for a shaped, restrained opening.
music.audition_check: Check that the full recording stays calm rather than relying only on its opening; assess phrase breathing.

music.title: Elysium in the Dream
music.fit_hypothesis: Alternative for a lighter, spacious introduction.
music.audition_check: Verify instrumentation and progression; the title alone does not establish solo piano.

music.title: A Faint Hope
music.fit_hypothesis: A contrast candidate for warmth without a busy pulse.
music.audition_check: Reject if the emotional arc feels too solemn for this welcoming opening.

music.title: Lon Lon Ranch

music.recording: Super Piano 64, Zelda & Piano: Ocarina of Time

music.title: Wet Hands

music.title: Minecraft

music.title: Subwoofer Lullaby

music.title: Awake
